item.description:
Deckz can now report its own problems.

"Report a Problem…" in the menu opens a bug report with the version you are running and your macOS version already filled in. Those are the two things a report is usually missing, and the two nobody should have to go and look up.

The website gained a page about installing, which explains why macOS refuses an early build the first time and what to do about it — including which button in that dialog not to press.

Settings now says who makes Deckz.
